[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708931/930412a1bf6b2de727f94e4c890c0c56e277bf74.jpg[/img]

Steam version of "TSUKUMOGAMIS!" Five days to go until the release!
Musubi, half 99 gods and half spirit of speech, is a half-human god.
He possesses a human in order to collect "good words," but the human he possesses is a girl with a communicative disorder that makes her forget how to speak!
This is the beginning of a slapstick drama!
